cases.title: Griffiths & Lane example 3, thin weak layer, cu2/cu1 = 0.2

references.disputed: Griffiths & Lane's 0.60 is read from fig. 7 on their mesh of 60 × 20 eight-node elements of 0.1H (fig. 8), one element across the inclined part of the weak layer, with failure as non-convergence in 1000 viscoplastic iterations. It disagrees with the paper's own Janbu wedge for the same mechanism (0.485) and with the limit analysis bounds, 0.488–0.498 (exact for φu = 0; cSlope's lower and upper bound programs on refined meshes): cSlope's strength reduction falls with the mesh, 0.64 on a uniform 0.2H mesh, 0.59 on 0.16H, 0.545 on 0.1H, 0.51 refined and 0.504 on a 0.5 m mesh, so the paper's value measures its mesh rather than cSlope. Not counted in the agreement or the error statistics.

fem.note: Griffiths & Lane: ψ = 0, E′ = 10⁵ kPa, ν′ = 0.3, failure as non-convergence in 1000 iterations, F to the nearest 0.05. Their value is a coarse-mesh value and disputed (see the reference); cSlope runs its usual refined mesh, on which the limit analysis bounds bracket the factor of safety.
